output.explanation: The warehouse has no forecast or budget table. All the listed tables (dim_customers, dim_products, dim_sales_reps, fct_order_lines, fct_orders, fct_payments) hold actual results only, so a forecast figure for Q1 2026 can't come from the data. Also, Q1 2026 is already over (today is 2026-11-26). If the actual Q1 2026 revenue is what you need, it can be queried as SUM(net_revenue) from marts.fct_orders where is_revenue is true and order_date is between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31.
